definitions.explanation: A flat shallow container for carrying or displaying things.
A Japanese Buddhist festival honoring the spirits of ancestors, typically in mid-August.

examples.english: Airfare goes up during the Obon period.

notes:
{盆|ぼん} has two main meanings: a serving tray and the Obon festival.

OBON FESTIVAL:
⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧ (Obon) is held in mid-August (or mid-July in some regions). It's one of Japan's most important holidays when people return to their hometowns to honor ancestors. Many companies close during this time.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧ (Obon festival)
- ⟦{盆踊|ぼんおど}り→盆踊り：05638_bonodori⟧ (Bon dance)
- ⟦{盆休|ぼんやす}み→盆休み：28288_bonyasumi⟧ (Obon holidays)
- ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}せる→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧ (to place on a tray)
